tools.name: get_wallet_positions
tools.description: Live Hyperliquid perp account snapshot for any wallet: account value, open positions (coin, side, size, entry, mark-based unrealized PnL, leverage, liquidation price), margin used and withdrawable. Public data, free.

tools.name: get_wallet_trades
tools.description: Recent Hyperliquid fills for a wallet (default last 24h, max 168h): direction (open/close long/short), coin, size, price, USD notional, realized PnL, fees, plus totals per coin. Free.

tools.name: start_wallet_alerts
tools.description: Push every new fill of up to 25 Hyperliquid wallets to a Discord webhook or Telegram bot within ~2 minutes. Free trial: 1 wallet for 3 days (no signup). Pro: 25 wallets, size filters, 5 USDC/month (key HW-... from https://hlwatch.deanhiki.workers.dev/#pro).
